title: charlesfoster/wasteline pipeline - params.input schema (mode 'demix')
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input in mode 'demix': existing Freyja variants and depths files

sample.errorMessage: Sample ID must be provided and may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'

variants.errorMessage: variants must be an existing Freyja variants table (.tsv or .tsv.gz) without spaces in its path

depths.errorMessage: depths must be an existing Freyja depths file (plain or .gz) without spaces in its path

fastp_json.errorMessage: fastp_json, if given, must be an existing .json file without spaces in its path

collection_date.errorMessage: collection_date must be an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)

protocol.errorMessage: protocol must be 'amplicon' or 'capture', or left blank for the run's --protocol

primer_scheme.errorMessage: primer_scheme must be a bundled scheme name or the path to a primer BED file, or left blank for the run's --primer_scheme/--primer_bed

viral_load.errorMessage: viral_load must be a positive number (e.g. gene copies per litre), or left blank
